import sys

MOD = 1000000007
MOD2 = 1007681537
INF = 10**9
LINF = 10**18
EPS = 1e-9

def gcd(a, b):
    while b:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

def lcm(a, b):
    return a // gcd(a, b) * b

def fpow(n, k, p=MOD):
    return pow(n, k, p)

def chkmin(a, val):
    if val < a:
        a = val
        return 1
    return 0

def chkmax(a, val):
    if a < val:
        a = val
        return 1
    return 0

def isqrt(k):
    r = int(k**0.5) + 1
    while r * r > k:
        r -= 1
    return r

def icbrt(k):
    r = int(k**(1/3)) + 1
    while r * r * r > k:
        r -= 1
    return r

def addmod(a, val, p=MOD):
    a += val
    if a >= p:
        a -= p
    return a

def submod(a, val, p=MOD):
    a -= val
    if a < 0:
        a += p
    return a

def mult(a, b, p=MOD):
    return (a * b) % p

def inv(a, p=MOD):
    return pow(a, p - 2, p)

def sign(x, y=None):
    if y is None:
        if x < -EPS:
            return -1
        if x > EPS:
            return 1
        return 0
    return sign(x - y)

def transform(a, n, p, invert):
    k = n.bit_length() - 1
    for i in range(k):
        step = 1 << i
        for msk in range(n):
            if (msk >> i) & 1:
                pmsk = msk ^ step
                if not invert:
                    a[msk] = (a[msk] + a[pmsk]) % p
                else:
                    a[msk] = (a[msk] - a[pmsk]) % p

def pow_convol(a, k, p):
    n = len(a)
    if k == 1:
        return a[:]
    if k & 1:
        r = pow_convol(a, k - 1, p)
        res = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            ri = r[i]
            if ri == 0:
                continue
            for j in range(n - i):
                res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + ri * a[j]) % p
        return res
    else:
        r = pow_convol(a, k >> 1, p)
        res = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            ri = r[i]
            if ri == 0:
                continue
            for j in range(n - i):
                res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + ri * r[j]) % p
        return res

def subset_pow_convol(a, k, p):
    logn = 19
    n2 = len(a)
    while n2 != (n2 & -n2):
        n2 += n2 & -n2
    fa = [[0] * n2 for _ in range(logn)]
    fc = [[0] * n2 for _ in range(logn)]
    for i in range(logn):
        for j in range(n2):
            if j.bit_count() == i:
                fa[i][j] = a[j] if j < len(a) else 0
            else:
                fa[i][j] = 0
            fc[i][j] = 0
        transform(fa[i], n2, p, 0)
    for mask in range(n2):
        va = [fa[i][mask] for i in range(logn)]
        vb = pow_convol(va, k, p)
        for i in range(logn):
            fc[i][mask] = vb[i]
    res = [0] * n2
    for i in range(logn):
        transform(fc[i], n2, p, 1)
        for j in range(n2):
            if j.bit_count() == i:
                res[j] = fc[i][j]
    return res

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    p = int(data[2])
    if n & 1:
        print(pow(k, n, p))
        return
    maxn = 1000005
    fac = [1] * (maxn)
    for i in range(1, maxn):
        fac[i] = (fac[i-1] * i) % p
    ifac = [1] * (maxn)
    ifac[maxn-1] = pow(fac[maxn-1], p-2, p)
    for i in range(maxn-2, -1, -1):
        ifac[i] = (ifac[i+1] * (i+1)) % p
    f = [0] * maxn
    nn = 0
    for i in range(n+1):
        if (n & i) == i:
            t = 0
            for j in range(20):
                if (n >> j) & 1:
                    t <<= 1
                    t |= (i >> j) & 1
            f[t] = i
            nn = t
    a = [0] * (nn+1)
    for i in range(nn+1):
        a[i] = ifac[f[i]]
    res = pow(k, n, p)
    a = subset_pow_convol(a, k, p)
    res = (res - (a[nn] * fac[n]) % p) % p
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
